rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being frightened or feeling fear.

example.english: I was very afraid of the dark when I was little.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 ging1 hak1

rows.note: Use this when you are worried about someone or something rather than personally frightened.

example.english: I'm afraid something might happen to Mum while she's home alone.
example.traditional: 我好擔心阿媽一個人喺屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 daam1 sam1 aa3 maa1 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this polite phrase when expressing regret or reluctance before saying something unpleasant.

example.english: Sorry, I'm afraid I can't go to the hospital with you because I'm afraid of seeing blood.
example.traditional: 唔好意思，我唔可以陪你去醫院，因為我好怕見到血。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 pui4 nei5 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 jan1 wai6 ngo5 hou2 paa3 gin3 dou2 hyut3
